[SWS_CRYPT_20005]
{DRAFT}
Freedom of interference during update
⌈
It must be
possible to regularly update any key pair of certificates, which are part of a
PKI
tree,
without affecting any other key pair of related certificates, which can be also part of the
same
PKI
tree or part of an independent tree.
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02112, RS_CRYPTO_-
02306)
